content.title: PS Plus: game catalogue for March 2026 revealed
content.text: The PS Plus game catalogue for March 2026 has been revealed, with subscribers on all tiers gaining access to a new array of blockbuster titles this month. The headliner is Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2, which sends you on a quest to take down the alien Tyranid hordes. Sharing the spotlight is EA Sports Madden NFL 26, which invites you into the world of American football (more commonly known as gridiron in Australia), and the award-winning urban fantasy RPG, Persona 5 Royal. Whether you’re in the mood for some crafting, exploring eldritch dungeon realms, destroying evil beasties, or fixing the hearts and minds of evildoers, there’s likely something for you in this lineup. New to PS Plus: Extra, Deluxe and Premium Persona 5 Royal. Image: Atlus / Sega. Here are all the new games coming to PS Plus on the Extra, Deluxe and Premium tiers on 17 March: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 (PS5) – ‘Purge the relentless Tyranid swarms as legendary Space Marine Titus in a spectacular new campaign. Enjoy intense, gory and fast-paced third-person action with hundreds of enemies on screen, from the creators of blockbuster co-op shooter World War Z.’ EA Sports Madden NFL 26 (PS5) – ‘Step into the All-Madden legacy this season. Experience generational playmakers, unlock rewards and celebrate football’s greatest coach.’ Persona 5 Royal (PS4, PS5) – ‘Expanding on the original 2017 release, Persona 5 Royal comes packed with new characters, confidants, story and locations and a new grappling hook mechanic for stealthy access to never-before-seen areas.’ Persona 5 Royal – Ultimate Edition (PS4) – ‘Persona 5 Royal Ultimate Edition includes the game and the Persona 5 Royal DLC Pack, including the costume, battle and persona DLC found in the Persona 5 Royal Kasumi Costume Bundle, as well as the Persona 5 Royal Battle Bundle, and the Persona 5 Royal Persona Bundle.’ Blasphemous 2 (PS4, PS5) – ‘Awakened in a strange new land, and displaced from his final resting place, The Penitent One is thrust back into the endless cycle of life, death and resurrection, with no other option than to explore this perilous new world and uncover its long-forgotten secrets.’ Metal Eden (PS5) – ‘Metal Eden is an adrenaline-rush sci-fi FPS. The advanced Hyper Unit Aska is sent on a suicide mission to rescue the citizens’ Cores from the vast monolithic city Moebius once a hopeful new home for humanity now turned into a deadly trap.’ The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria (PS5) – ‘The Lord of the Rings: Return to Moria follows the Dwarves as they embark on a new adventure to reclaim their legendary home beneath the Misty Mountains.’ Astroneer (PS4, PS5) – ‘Reshape the ground under your feet as though it were made of clay. In Astroneer, players use their deform tool to dig, collect, shape and build anything they wish.’ New to PS Plus: Premium and Deluxe In addition to the above titles, those on the Premium and Deluxe PS Plus tiers will also gain access to the following classic title: Tekken Dark Resurrection (PS4, PS5) – ‘The popular 3D fighting game Tekken 5 Dark Resurrection breaks out of the arcade with all new systems and features! Experience the captivating stories of Armor King and newcomers Lili and Dragunov, unique openings and endings for each character, and even an all-new opening CG movie.’ This game, originally released for the PlayStation Portable, is one of the more underrated titles in the Tekken series. It’s great to see it available for modern consoles. Discover more screen, games & arts news and reviews on ScreenHub and ArtsHub. Sign up for our free ArtsHub and ScreenHub newsletters.
